While TCP is used for applications like web browsing, UDP is preferred for real time applications like video streaming due to its speed.
Authored claim: TCP provides ordered data delivery.

Source text: Overfitting occurs when a machine learning model learns the training data too well, including noise and irrelevant details. Techniques such as regularization, cross-validation, and reducing model complexity can help prevent overfitting.
